name: MobileNavServerItem
description: The tab: the server's avatar and its name in `MobileNavLabel`, as children. A press opens the popover, and so does holding it for 500ms (the long press of raft-ui's menus). Lifting the finger after a hold never closes it: the click that ends the hold is not a press, whether the hold opened the popover or found it open. It is never `selected`: it holds no page.

name: MobileNavServerPopover
description: The root: owns the popover's open state, like `Popover` (`open`, `onOpenChange`).

props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Manually unmounts the popover. Call this after any externally controlled closing animation finishes. - `close`: Closes the popover imperatively when called.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover. This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popover is initially open.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the popover is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open popover.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the popover enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to the popover: document page scroll is locked, and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed. - `'trap-focus'`: focus is trapped inside the popover, but document page scroll is not locked and pointer interactions outside of it remain enabled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the popover is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the popover is opened or closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popover is currently open.

props.name: triggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the popover is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled popover. There's no need to specify this prop when the popover is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

name: MobileNavServerPopoverContent
description: The popover above the tab bar, 8px from each side of it and 8px above it, as tall as its content and at most 60% of the screen. It stops below the top safe area (a notch in a standalone web app): Base UI's collision padding takes only pixels, so the height cap subtracts `env(safe-area-inset-top)`. The bottom needs none: the tab bar under the popover already pads the bottom safe area. A column: `MobileNavServerPopoverList` takes the room left and scrolls, and the destinations and the footer after it stay in view.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null)
props.description: An element to position the popup against. By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the popover is closed.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => void | boolean | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the popover is opened. By default, focus moves to the first tabbable element inside the popup, except when the popover is opened by touch — then the popup itself is focused to avoid opening the virtual keyboard.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.

name: MobileNavServerPopoverList
description: The server list: takes the room left in the popover and scrolls inside it.

name: MobileNavServerPopoverGroup
description: Rows that always stay in view, such as the footer actions.

name: MobileNavServerPopoverRow
description: One line at the option height of every popup list (`min-h-option`, 36px): a 20px avatar or a 16px icon, `MobileNavServerPopoverRowLabel`, then anything trailing (a check, a count). `aria-current="true"` marks the current server in bold.

name: MobileNavServerPopoverRowLabel
description: A row's label: takes the room and truncates.

name: MobileNavServerPopoverDestinations
description: The server's own pages, side by side in equal cells; a `group`, named with `aria-label`.

name: MobileNavServerPopoverDestination
description: One of the server's pages: a 20px icon over a short label in a `span`, which truncates. Something new on that page (a feedback reply, a computer that needs attention) is an `accent` `Status` child, the attention dot at the icon's top-right corner: the server tab's avatar never carries it.
